If you are in immediate danger, call 112. I have let your care team know so they can reach out to you.

Thank you for telling me. I'm really sorry you're feeling this way, and you don't have to face it alone. Please call Tele-MANAS now on 14416 (free, 24x7) to talk to a trained counsellor. Mujhe batane ke liye shukriya. Mujhe bahut afsos hai ki aap aisa mehsoos kar rahe ho, aur aapko yeh akele nahi jhelna hai. Please abhi Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo (free, 24x7), wahan trained counsellor se baat hogi. Agar aap turant khatre mein ho toh 112 par call karo. Maine aapki care team ko bata diya hai, woh aapse contact karenge.

Kya hum abhi ek chhota sa plan banate hain taaki aap exam se pehle thoda relax feel kar sakein?
